releaseNotes: Simpler Shopping List: total, quick item addition and checklist first, with no unnecessary menus, weekly essentials dropdown or progress bars. Added items appear in an Additions group at the top, with a simple unboxed X to remove them.
Refined shopping total typography and spacing across devices. Known ingredient prices remain visible when a manually added item has no local price, with the subtotal clearly labelled.
Australia now has national grocery price estimates and shopping calculations alongside the existing United Kingdom experience, using one shared catalogue design.
Expanded comparative ingredient pricing across all 3,252 recipes, with eight UK and four Australian supermarket choices. Prices are estimates, not live local shelf prices.
Improved cross-country quantity conversion and budget safeguards while retaining existing meals, favourites, cupboards and shopping check-offs.
